training.historical_teacher_selection: all successful actual Astra TEI/TLI trajectories from seed29 phase evaluation and the two seed19 pilot text rescues
training.fresh_anchor_admission: completed simulator success only; all collection costs retained
training.selector_features: native final prefix block: mean valid visual slots, mean instruction slots, raw robot state8
training.head_supervision: masked first min(5,actually_executed) rows and first7 channels; smooth bounded residual native flow objective
training.head_suffix: new original-condition native sample for unexecuted physical rows, zero clean padding; imputation only, never supervision

evaluation.policy_noise: fresh full dimensional Gaussian keyed by episode_id,seed,step; shared across arms

recorded_schedule.tie_break: lowest revision then lexicographic episode_id and trajectory_id
recorded_schedule.clock: absolute executed action count; latest recorded applied choice at or before step

interpretation: offline distillation on known task compositions; new-reset transfer and limited four-task ID retention, not held-out-task or zero-shot generalization
